acceptance: A producer that starts while the jobs API lags by more than 60 seconds still binds, or fails with a message that names the lag and says a rerun is safe
A test covers the lag with a fake jobs API and fails with the 60-second limit in place
The change keeps the fail-closed admission rules in docs/internal/release-artifacts.md
context: Found 2026-10-30 while diagnosing a red develop. The step log was not available, so the lag is an inference from the 93-second failure and the job having waited 2.5 hours for a runner. This is release-adjacent supply-chain code that another session owns while v0.5.0 is in flight; do not edit it without that owner's agreement.
description: scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py producer polls the jobs API for 60 seconds (PRODUCER_WAIT_SECONDS) until its own job is listed in_progress. Under load the listing lagged and the 'Bind distributions to the producer attempt' step failed about 93 seconds after the job started: Trunk run 41081078735 (commit 5635b1417) and run 41081661345 (commit f4e091e12). A failed producer leaves that commit without a releasable artifact and turns Trunk red for a cause unrelated to the code.
